2607.09449.title: How Does Bayesian Causal Discovery Fail? Characterising Structural Consequences in Linear Gaussian Networks under Latent Confounding
2607.09449.paper_summary: Bayesian causal discovery is widely used for its ability to quantify epistemic uncertainty over directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) through posterior inference. However, its behaviour under latent confounding remains poorly understood, as existing work typically notes that confounding breaks identifiability without characterising how the posterior distribution over DAGs responds. In this work, we analyse posterior behaviour under latent confounding in linear Gaussian causal models, focusing on additive latent confounding between exactly two observed variables. We derive a critical correlation threshold above which the score function favours graphs with a spurious edge between the confounded variables, and show that this threshold decreases with sample size -- more data lowers the correlation required for the spurious edge to be favoured. Beyond this threshold, we characterize two distinct posterior failure regimes determined by the local structure around the confounded variables. Our findings are supported by exact posterior computations on multiple graph structures, demonstrating both the predicted failure regimes.
2607.09449.paper_summary_zh: 貝葉斯因果發現因其能夠通過後驗推斷量化有向無環圖（DAGs）上的認知不確定性而被廣泛使用。<lb/>然而，其在潛在混淆下的行為仍然不甚了解，因為現有的研究通常指出混淆會破壞可識別性，但未能描述後驗分佈對DAGs的反應。<lb/>在本研究中，我們分析了線性高斯因果模型中潛在混淆下的後驗行為，重點關注恰好兩個觀察變量之間的加性潛在混淆。<lb/>我們推導出一個關鍵的相關性閾值，超過該閾值後，得分函數偏好於混淆變量之間存在虛假邊的圖形，並顯示該閾值隨樣本大小的增加而降低——更多數據降低了虛假邊被偏好的所需相關性。<lb/>在這個閾值之外，我們描述了由混淆變量周圍的局部結構決定的兩個不同的後驗失效範疇。<lb/>我們的發現得到了對多個圖結構的精確後驗計算的支持，展示了預測的失效範疇。
